items.title: Undeclared environment variable "JWT_SECRET"
items.summary: Environment variable "JWT_SECRET" is accessed in code but is not declared in .env.example.
items.likely_cause: A new feature added process.env access but .env.example was not updated.
items.not_confirmed: It may be set in the deployment environment or injected by CI/CD secrets.

items.title: Isolated file "MarksTable.tsx" is never imported or tested
items.summary: The file "frontend/src/components/MarksTable.tsx" has no incoming imports, calls, or test references in the project graph.
items.likely_cause: Dead code left after a refactor, an abandoned module, or an unreferenced utility file.
items.not_confirmed: It may be loaded dynamically, by a framework, or by a build tool.
